network.evidenceType: Automated bot clients over a real localhost WebSocket proxy; no browser prediction, physical devices or human playtest
network.technique: Seeded uniform delay per direction, ordered delivery; 1% Bernoulli loss on input/snapshot application messages only. Handshake, Ready, ping/pong and control messages retained. This is application-message loss, not TCP/kernel packet loss.
